change.cjs and exports-check.cjs both parse TypeScript exports, but they answer different questions. change.cjs diffs one file's export names between two commits. exports-check.cjs asks the type checker which exports any program imports. A shared helper would join two unrelated uses.
models uses 'satisfies Record<ModelKey, ModelConfig>', which keeps each entry's literal type for narrowing. project/no-type-assertion allows only 'as const', and its allow list is empty.
